purpose: Centralize professional account, firm organization, seat, office, billing-foundation, and entitlement metadata in Smarter Justice while dedicated legal portals own specialty user experiences and source-specific public rendering.
ownerDecisions: One Smarter Justice professional identity across qualifying legal portals.
One firm organization account for multiple professionals, offices, practice groups, seats, permissions, and centralized billing.
Fixed per-professional seat architecture with owner-approved volume discounts; no separate full base subscription for each portal.
Each individual practice and portal assignment requires independent evidence.
Payment never buys verification, unsupported specialties, endorsement, organic rank, inquiries, clients, or outcomes.
Corrections and removal do not require payment.
privacyBoundary: No user legal matters, uploaded documents, credentials, payment details, private claims, or production secrets in portal coordination exports.
